name: @opentask/taskin-situation
description: Situational awareness for Taskin: the resources at hand, the constraints, and how to run each task
motivation: Knowing which machines, LLM accesses, libraries, channels and sensors are available, and against what limits, is what decides how each task should run. Today that knowledge lives only in hand-written prose.
solve: Specifies, as use cases with a contract suite and then as plugin types, the inventory, the probing, the credential lease, the run ledger and the scheduler, so every implementation is checked against the same contract.
